profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
While working as a social worker with child protective services,  I made my first number guessing game in Python and realized software engineering would be a great way to combine my love to learn, solve problems and create things. I'm looking forward to working as a software engineer at a company that is excited about helping people through technology.

TECHNOLOGIES
Languages | Python, JavaScript (AJAX, JSON), HTML, CSS, SQL
Frameworks & Libraries | Flask, jQuery, Bootstrap, Jinja, React, SQLAlchemy 
Database/Industry Tools | PostgreSQL, Git, GitHub, Command Line

positions.title: Social Worker
positions.description:
Coordinate with foster family agencies, short term residential treatment facilities, social workers, and foster parents to find appropriate and timely placement for foster children.
Gather information for placement referrals and assess children's placement needs.
Manage and prioritize up to 10 child placement referral cases based on child’s needs and varying deadlines.
Organize and process documents to refer children to short term residential treatment facilities.

positions.title: Social Worker
positions.description:
Scheduled, coordinated, and facilitated supervised visitation for foster children with their parents.
Maintained detailed, objective documentation of all client interactions for potential use in juvenile court.
Coordinated visitation appointments with up to five different parties, including parents, foster parents, foster family agencies, and other staff members for up to 17 different families.
Managed a caseload of up to 30 children placed with non-related legal guardians including home visits and school visits occurring twice per year.
Supported social workers with various tasks as needed, including transporting foster children to court, visitation, placements, and therapeutic appointments.

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description:
Organized, maintained, and digitized medical records for healthcare provider use using Epic and OnBase systems in addition to managing paper medical records.
Answered phone calls from patients and providers requesting confidential health information, releasing information where appropriate.

positions.title: Peer Facilitator
positions.description:
Presented to freshman college students regarding sexual assault and dating violence prevention and intervention on campus to mixed gender groups of up to 30 students for 1.5 hours each.
Created and updated Prezi presentations in a collaborative group, incorporating audio-visual elements such as videos and interactive polls.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: STAND! For Families Free of Violence
volunteerExperiences.description:
Supported Crisis Line Staff with emergency phone calls and client intake.
Coordinate and deliver regular community food donations for the residents of the temporary shelter.

company.name: STAND! For Families Free of Violence
